article.excerpt: OpenAI's Sora 2 has fundamentally changed video creation, transforming text descriptions into cinematic footage that rivals professional production. Yet most users struggle to unlock its full potential. This guide reveals the 7-element framework professionals use to craft prompts that produce broadcast-quality results.

content_sections.heading: AIDA Opening
content_sections.content: OpenAI's Sora 2 has fundamentally changed video creation, transforming text descriptions into cinematic footage that rivals professional production. Yet most users struggle to unlock its full potential, generating generic clips instead of compelling stories. The difference isn't the AI—it's the prompt. Master Sora 2's prompt structure, and you'll create videos that capture emotion, movement, and atmosphere with precision. This guide reveals the 7-element framework professionals use to craft prompts that produce broadcast-quality results, complete with examples, strategies, and a practical checklist you can apply immediately.

content_sections.heading: What Makes Sora 2 Different from Other AI Video Tools
key_points: Extended duration: Generate videos up to 60 seconds long
Cinematic camera work: Professional movements including dolly shots and tracking
Physical realism: Real-world physics, lighting, and reflections
Character consistency: Maintains appearance across scenes
Environmental depth: Detailed backgrounds with atmospheric effects
content_sections.citable_quote: Sora 2's ability to maintain narrative and visual consistency across 60-second clips represents a breakthrough that separates it from previous AI video generation tools, which typically struggled beyond 5-10 seconds.

content_sections.heading: Understanding Prompt Structure for Sora 2

strategies.name: Descriptive Strategy
strategies.description: Focuses on what the AI should show through rich sensory details

strategies.name: Directive Strategy
strategies.description: Focuses on how the AI should film by specifying camera movements

seven_elements.description: Specify the video style and length expectations
examples: Cinematic 4K footage, 45 seconds
Documentary-style handheld, 30 seconds
Time-lapse sequence, 20 seconds

seven_elements.description: Define how the camera moves through the scene
examples: Slow dolly-in from wide shot to medium close-up
Steadicam following subject from behind
Static low-angle shot looking up
Orbital drone shot circling the subject

seven_elements.description: Establish the physical setting with specific details
examples: Abandoned Art Deco theater, velvet seats covered in dust
Minimalist Tokyo apartment, floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking neon streets
Rocky Pacific coastline, tide pools reflecting overcast sky

seven_elements.description: Control mood and atmosphere through light quality
examples: Golden hour backlight creating rim glow on subject
Harsh midday sun creating stark shadows
Soft overcast light, even exposure
Neon signs casting colored light on wet pavement

seven_elements.description: Describe what moves within the frame
examples: Subject walks slowly toward camera, coat billowing in wind
Leaves falling in slow motion
Crowds moving in time-lapse blur while subject stands still

seven_elements.description: Specify who or what appears in the scene
examples: Woman in her 30s, wearing vintage leather jacket, confident expression
Tabby cat sitting on window sill
Classic 1960s Mustang, cherry red with chrome details

seven_elements.description: Audio descriptors that inform visual tone (optional but powerful)
examples: Tense silence, as if waiting for something to happen
Peaceful, meditative atmosphere
Energetic, fast-paced mood

content_sections.citable_quote: The 7-element prompt framework—Format, Camera, Location, Lighting, Motion, Subject, and Audio/Mood—provides a systematic approach to crafting Sora 2 prompts that consistently produce cinematic results.

short_prompt.title: Short Prompt Example (Descriptive Strategy)
short_prompt.prompt: Wide shot of a glass coffee shop at night, warm interior lighting contrasting with dark rainy street outside. Customers move in slow motion inside while rain streams down windows. Camera static, 25 seconds, cinematic depth of field.
elements_covered: Format: Cinematic depth of field, 25 seconds
Location: Glass coffee shop, rainy street
Lighting: Warm interior vs. dark exterior
Motion: Customers in slow motion, rain streaming

long_prompt.title: Long Prompt Example (Blended Strategy)
long_prompt.prompt: Cinematic 4K drone footage, 50 seconds. Opening with a slow ascending shot from ground level in a vast lavender field in Provence at golden hour. Purple flowers stretch to the horizon under warm amber light. As camera rises to 30 feet, it begins a gradual forward dolly movement, revealing a rustic stone farmhouse in the distance with terracotta roof tiles catching the sunset glow. Light wind creates subtle waves across the lavender rows. Camera continues forward and slightly upward, banking gently right to frame the farmhouse off-center with mountains visible on the horizon. Soft, dreamy atmosphere with gentle lens flare from the setting sun. A sense of peaceful isolation and timeless beauty.
elements_covered: Camera: Ascending drone shot, forward dolly, gentle bank right
Location: Lavender field in Provence, stone farmhouse, mountains
Lighting: Golden hour, amber light, sunset glow, lens flare
Motion: Wind creating waves in lavender, camera movements
Subject: Lavender field, farmhouse with terracotta roof
Mood: Peaceful isolation, timeless beauty, dreamy

content_sections.heading: Sora 2 Prompt Checklist
essential_elements: Time of day or lighting quality mentioned
quality_enhancers: Specific visual style mentioned (cinematic, documentary, etc.)
Duration indicated (helps AI pace the action)
Technical details (4K, depth of field, etc.) if desired
avoid: Overly complex scenes with too many simultaneous actions
content_sections.citable_quote: Effective Sora 2 prompts balance specificity with clarity—provide enough detail to guide the AI's creative decisions without overwhelming it with contradictory or overly complex instructions.

steps.title: Choose Your Primary Strategy
steps.description: Decide between descriptive (mood-focused), directive (camera-focused), or blended approach

steps.title: Build Your Prompt Using the 7-Element Framework
steps.description: Work through each element systematically to construct a complete prompt

steps.title: Generate and Refine
steps.description: Submit prompt, review output for quality markers, and iterate if needed

steps.title: Advanced Techniques
steps.description: Try camera transitions, time-based action, or atmospheric layering

mistakes.why_it_fails: Too many competing elements create visual chaos
mistakes.solution: Focus on 1-2 primary elements with supporting details

mistakes.why_it_fails: Subjective adjectives like 'beautiful' or 'nice' provide no actionable guidance
mistakes.solution: Use specific, observable details about light, color, and composition

mistakes.why_it_fails: Results in generic, often static shots
mistakes.solution: Always specify camera angle, movement, or explicitly state 'static shot'
Review prompt for logical consistency before submitting
Specify light sources, quality, and direction

content_sections.heading: Optimizing Prompts for Different Video Types

video_types.focus: Lighting, camera angles that highlight features, clean backgrounds
video_types.template: [Camera movement] of [product] on [surface/background]. [Lighting description] highlights [key features]. [Duration], [visual style]. [Mood/brand alignment].

video_types.focus: Character details, sequential action, emotional atmosphere
video_types.template: [Camera movement] following [character description] as they [action sequence]. [Environment]. [Lighting/time of day]. [Emotional tone]. [Duration].

video_types.focus: Environment, mood, subtle movements, visual aesthetics
video_types.template: [Camera type/movement] of [environment/scene]. [Atmospheric details]. [Lighting quality]. [Subtle motion]. [Mood descriptors]. [Duration].

video_types.focus: Camera movement, motion blur, energy, pacing
video_types.template: [Dynamic camera movement] capturing [action]. [Environment]. [Lighting for drama/contrast]. [Motion characteristics]. [Energetic mood]. [Duration].

content_sections.citable_quote: Different video types require distinct prompt optimization strategies—product videos emphasize lighting and angles, narrative videos focus on character and sequence, while b-roll prioritizes atmosphere and subtle environmental details.

content_sections.heading: Your Sora 2 Prompt Mastery Action Plan
content_sections.key_takeaway: Creating cinematic AI videos with Sora 2 comes down to systematic prompt engineering using the 7-element framework.
next_steps: Start simple: Practice with 3-4 element prompts before attempting complex scenes
Build a prompt library: Save successful prompts and note what worked
Iterate systematically: Change one element at a time to understand its impact
Study visual references: Analyze films, photos, and videos you admire
Join the community: Share prompts and learn from other Sora 2 creators
